resources.string: Allow location
Meret records where you walk and where you collect data. It cannot work without your location.
Location is blocked for Meret. In «Settings», open «Permissions», then «Location», and allow it.
Turn on precise location
You allowed approximate location only. It can be 1–3 km off, too far to map a field. Choose «Precise».
Meret has approximate location only. In «Settings», open «Permissions», then «Location», and turn on «Use precise location».
Allow notifications
While a track records, a notification shows its distance, with Pause and Stop buttons. Without this permission the notification is hidden.
Keep recording with the screen off
To record a track while the phone is in your pocket, Meret needs location all the time. It uses it only while you record a track.
To record a track while the phone is in your pocket, Meret needs location all the time. It uses it only while you record a track. On the next screen, choose «Allow all the time».
Stop battery saver ending tracks
To save battery, Android can stop Meret and end a track without warning. Allow Meret to run in the background.
